Retrieve yellow notepad content for a specific appointment and template combination.

Both appointment_id and template_id must be provided as query parameters.

Create or update yellow notepad content for a specific appointment and template combination.

This endpoint has different behavior based on the template's workflow_key:

Regular templates (workflow_key != 'hp_meds_allergies'):
- Automatically includes this template in the note
- Content is appointment-specific

Medications/Allergies templates (workflow_key == 'hp_meds_allergies'):
- Content is patient-level (shared across appointments)

Both appointment_id and template_id must be provided as que

items.docs: Retrieve or search patients in batches. This resource returns identical data to `GET /api/patients` but uses an asynchronous batch-based approach to data delivery. This is an efficient choice for large historical record loading use cases. Retrieve the results/status of a previously created patient_list request using the UUID returned in the response. Results are ordered by patient ID number.

params.name: order_by
params.description: Order results by a specific field. Valid options include [id, updated_at]. Default: id.

params.name: gender
params.description: Filter the list for the patient's gender.

params.name: since
params.description: Filter the list for when the patient was created or updated.  The value should be a date in the format YYYY-MM-DD.  For example, to filter for patients created or updated on or after 2019-01-01, use the value 2019-01-01.

params.name: date_of_birth
params.description: Filter the list for the patient's date of birth.  The value should be a date in the format YYYY-MM-DD.  For example, to filter for patients born on 2019-01-01, use the value 2019-01-01.

params.name: race
params.description: Filter the list for the patients' race.

params.name: chart_id
params.description: Filter the list for the patients' chart id.

params.name: email
params.description: Filter the list for the patients' email.

params.name: ethnicity
params.description: Filter the list for the patients' ethnicity.

params.name: verbose
params.description: when `true` include additional verbose fields in the response.

items.docs: Retrieve or search schedule blocks. Schedule blocks are used to block off time on a provider's calendar to prevent appointments from being scheduled. Use this to retrieve existing blocks for lunch breaks, meetings, PTO, or other non-appointment activities. Either `date` or `date_range` parameter is recommended for efficient querying.

Create a new schedule block to block off time on a provider's calendar. This prevents appointments from being scheduled during the specified time period. Use this to block time for lunch breaks, meetings, administrative tasks, PTO, or other activities.
